azure_blob_name.description: Blob name for Azure Blob Storage. Defaults to 'ipam-storage.json'

azure_connection_string.description: Connection string for Azure Blob Storage. Required for 'azure_blob' backend.

azure_container_name.description: Container name for Azure Blob Storage. Required for 'azure_blob' backend.

file_path.description: Path to storage file for 'file' storage backend. Required for 'file' backend. Defaults to '.terraform/ipam-storage.json'

s3_access_key_id.description: AWS Access Key ID. Optional - uses default AWS credential chain if not provided.

s3_bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name. Required for 'aws_s3' backend.

s3_endpoint_url.description: Custom S3 endpoint URL. Optional - for S3 compatible services like MinIO or LocalStack.

s3_object_key.description: S3 object key (file path). Defaults to 'ipam-storage.json'

s3_region.description: AWS region for S3 bucket. Required for 'aws_s3' backend.

s3_secret_access_key.description: AWS Secret Access Key. Required if s3_access_key_id is provided.

s3_session_token.description: AWS Session Token. Optional - for temporary credentials.

s3_skip_tls_verify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Optional - can be useful with self signed certificates on S3 compatible services

storage_type.description: Storage backend type. Supported values: 'file' (default), 'azure_blob' (Azure Blob Storage), 'aws_s3' (AWS S3)

block.description: IPAM provider for managing IP address pools and allocations

pool_name.description: Name of the pool to allocate from

prefix_length.description: Prefix length for the allocated CIDR (e.g., 32 for a single IPv4 host)

block.description: IPAM allocation resource for allocating IP addresses from a pool

cidrs.description: List of CIDR blocks in the pool

block.description: IPAM pool resource for managing IP address ranges

allocated_cidr.description: CIDR block allocated to the resource

pool_name.description: Name of the pool the allocation belongs to

prefix_length.description: Prefix length of the allocated CIDR

block.description: Allocation data source for retrieving IP allocations from a pool
IPAM pool data source for managing IP address ranges
